application: Apply each old/new substring pair once to the specified 04 b1_text, in listed order; the result is the corrected 05 lexical base used for vocalisation_03. The uploaded 04 file is unchanged.

entries.note: Mirqāt p200 prints إداوة and الإداوة; 04 transposed alif and wāw in both words. This is a lexical correction, not vowel transfer.
Mirqāt p211 and Bushrā p103 show the ﷺ honorific after النبي. The 04 string ولللق is OCR corruption of that glyph; retained Mirqāt's sentence punctuation.
